resources.string: Calibrate pinch
Fit the strap snugly and raise your wrist. Follow the cues: rest, six double pinches, then arm movement without pinching. No music commands are sent.
Start / retry

Keep your wrist still. Do not pinch.
Attempt %1$d of 6\nDouble pinch now.
Relax. Wait for the next cue.
Next: move your arm without pinching.
Move and turn your wrist normally. Do not pinch.
Samples collected. Test without actions before saving. Try pinching, then ordinary arm movements. This detector is experimental.
The samples could not be separated reliably. Adjust the strap, keep the wrist steady during pinches and retry. The previous saved calibration was kept.
Test interrupted when the screen became inactive. Start again with the screen awake.
Motion sensors unavailable. Reopen this screen and try again.
Test only

Detections: %1$d. Check whether the count matches your double pinches. If arm movements were counted, recalibrate or lower sensitivity on the phone.
Saving on phone…
Calibration saved. On your phone, select Experimental in Pinch settings and save. Assign an action for both playback states.
Could not confirm saving on the phone. Check the connection, update both apps and tap Save calibration to retry.
